title: Custom Hooks with Types
description: Learn how to create typed custom hooks.

data.text: Custom hooks are functions that use other hooks. They can have typed parameters and return values.

data.title: Custom Hook
Parameterized Hook
Return Tuple for Flexibility
data.text: Returning a tuple instead of an object lets consumers name the variables: const [data, loading] = useFetch<User[]>('/api/users')

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Custom hooks are functions using other hooks
data.takeaway: Well-typed custom hooks are reusable and safe.
